declaration.package_zh: 万感京张 零授权现场验证计划 —— 六项空间读数、无障碍路径实测协议与最小访谈集的执行办法
declaration.package_en: Every-Sense Jingzhang zero-authorisation field verification plan -- execution method for the six spatial readings, the accessibility-route test protocol and the minimum interview set
statement_zh: 本文件是计划，不是结果。截至签发日，六项读数与本计划涉及的一切现场值全部为零值或 unknown，一个数字都还没有产出。
「零授权」的含义严格限定为：全部动作在公共可进入空间内以公众身份完成，不需要场地授权、不需要主体许可、不进入任何受限区域、不触碰任何设施、不采集任何个体身份信息。它不意味着不需要伦理约束——访谈部分的伦理约束比技术部分更严。
本计划不承诺执行日期。执行角色如实登记为「提交者本人或其自愿邀请的志愿者」，本方案没有已组建的团队，也不虚构团队。
本计划不替代专业审查：任何一项读数都不构成合规判定、验收结论或达标声明。
statement_en: This file is a plan, not a result. As of its issue date every one of the six readings and every field value it concerns is zero or unknown; not one number exists yet.

Zero-authorisation is strictly defined: every action is performed in publicly enterable space as a member of the public, requiring no site authorisation and no owner's permission, entering no restricted area, touching no equipment and collecting no individual identity data. It does not mean free of ethical constraint; the interview part is bound more tightly than the technical part.
The plan commits to no execution date. The executing role is registered truthfully as the submitter in person or volunteers they invite; this proposal has no assembled team and invents none.
The plan replaces no professional review: no reading it produces constitutes a compliance determination, an acceptance conclusion or a claim of conformity.

relation_to_existing_files.extends_zh: 本文件不重复 visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json 已登记的定义、单位与责任方，只补该文件未含的四件事：零授权工具、记录字段定义、样本量参考与有效性条件。两文件按 reading_id 一一对应。
relation_to_existing_files.extends_en: This file does not repeat the definitions, units and owners already registered in visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json. It adds the four things that file lacks: zero-authorisation tools, record field definitions, reference sample sizes and validity conditions. The two correspond one to one by reading_id.
relation_to_existing_files.ethics_zh: 访谈部分不新设伦理规则，全部挂 visual/assets/ethics-protocol.json 既有六条协议 P1 招募、P2 合理便利、P3 知情同意、P4 撤回、P5 申诉、P6 数据处置。任一条不成立，访谈不得开始。
relation_to_existing_files.ethics_en: The interview part creates no new ethical rule and hangs entirely on the six protocols already in visual/assets/ethics-protocol.json: P1 recruitment, P2 reasonable accommodation, P3 informed consent, P4 withdrawal, P5 appeal, P6 data disposal. If any one fails, interviewing does not begin.
relation_to_existing_files.personas_zh: 访谈问题框架挂正文六维度任务约束（信息获取通道、沟通方式、行动方式、认知与感官处理、语言与数字门槛、服务提供与维护），按维度组织问题而非按人群组织问题。
relation_to_existing_files.personas_en: The interview question frame hangs on the six task-constraint dimensions in the text (information channel, communication mode, movement mode, cognitive and sensory processing, language and digital thresholds, service provision and maintenance), organising questions by dimension and never by population group.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 测距轮或卷尺 + 手机（计时与定位截图）；无需任何账户、许可或场地授权。
readings_execution.tools_en: Measuring wheel or tape plus a phone for timing and a location screenshot; no account, permit or site authorisation required.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 节点对参考量：十节点中相邻节点两两成对，首轮建议覆盖不少于 6 对，且必须包含三处横向接口各 1 对。样本量为参考值，实际以可安全通行的节点对为准。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: Reference pairing: adjacent pairs among the ten nodes; a first round should cover at least six pairs and must include one pair at each of the three lateral interfaces. The sample size is a reference; the actual set is limited to pairs that can be walked safely.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 晴天、日间；两条路径须在同一次外出中连续实走，间隔不超过 2 小时，避免施工围挡在两次之间变化。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: Fair weather, daytime; both routes walked continuously within one outing no more than two hours apart, so that hoarding cannot change between them.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 若任一路径中途不可通行，不得以估算补足：该对登记为不可测并写明原因，分母保留该对。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: If either route becomes impassable, the pair must not be completed by estimation: it is registered as unmeasurable with the reason stated, and the pair stays in the denominator.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 秒表（手机自带）+ 计数表；站位在人行道内，不进入车行道，不需要任何授权。
readings_execution.tools_en: A stopwatch (the phone's own) and a tally sheet; the observer stands on the footway, never enters the carriageway, and needs no authorisation.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 每处横向接口不少于 10 个完整信号周期；无信号处记不少于 10 次可穿越间隙。三处接口各测一轮为一批。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: At least ten full signal cycles at each lateral interface, or at least ten crossable gaps where unsignalised. One round at each of the three interfaces makes one batch.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 工作日与休息日各一轮；每轮在早高峰、平峰、晚高峰三个时段中至少覆盖两个，时段须逐条登记。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: One round on a weekday and one at the weekend; each round covers at least two of the morning peak, off-peak and evening peak, with the period registered on every record.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 同一周期内被遮挡未看清信号变化的样本作废重测，不得按前一周期推定。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: Any cycle in which the signal change was obscured is void and re-measured; it must never be inferred from the previous cycle.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 手机（拍照与定位）+ 卷尺（量积水宽度与深度）+ 雨具；无需授权。
readings_execution.tools_en: A phone for photographs and location, a tape for ponding width and depth, and rain gear; no authorisation required.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 复走晴天基线路径全程；断点为全数登记而非抽样，无最小样本量，但须登记本次复走的总里程。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: The whole fair-weather baseline route is re-walked; breaks are recorded exhaustively rather than sampled, so there is no minimum sample size, but the distance re-walked is registered.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 须在降雨期间或降雨停止后 30 分钟内完成；须先存在一次晴天基线复走记录，否则本项无参照系不成立。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: Carried out during rainfall or within thirty minutes of its ending; it requires an existing fair-weather baseline run, without which the reading has no reference and does not stand.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 无晴天基线的雨天记录只作为断点照片存档，不产出读数。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: A wet-weather run without a fair-weather baseline is archived as break photographs only and produces no reading.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 手机照度计应用 + 手机拍照 + 白杖（如有使用者参与）；照度计应用为非计量器具，读数按「未标定」登记。
readings_execution.tools_en: A phone illuminance app, the phone camera, and a white cane where a cane user takes part; the app is not a calibrated instrument and its readings are registered as uncalibrated.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 复走同一基线路径全程；照度在每处断点与每 200 米各取一点，全程不少于 20 个照度采样。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: The same baseline route is re-walked in full; illuminance is sampled at every break and every 200 metres, at least twenty samples per run.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 日落后两小时内开始；同一路径的晴夜与雨夜各一轮，两轮不得合并为一个读数。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: Begins within two hours after sunset; one round on a clear night and one in rain, and the two rounds are never merged into one reading.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 照度值一律带「未标定」标记登记；未标定读数不得与任何规范限值比较，只用于同一路径不同点位之间的相对比较。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: Every illuminance value is registered as uncalibrated; an uncalibrated reading is never compared against a standard's limit and serves only for relative comparison between points on the same route.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 白杖实探 + 卷尺 + 手机拍照定位；白杖探测须由白杖使用者本人执行，视力正常者的模拟不作为读数来源。
readings_execution.tools_en: White-cane probing, a tape and a phone for photographs and location; the probing is performed by a cane user, and simulation by a sighted person is not a source of readings.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 以 200 米为一段逐段实探；首轮覆盖主脊连续段不少于 2 公里，三处横向接口全长各一次。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: Probed segment by segment in 200 metre lengths; a first round covers at least two kilometres of continuous spine plus the full length of each of the three lateral interfaces.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 晴天日间；同一段落须同时记录目视发现与白杖探得两组结果，两组不一致本身即为一条记录。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: Fair weather, daytime; every segment records both what was seen and what the cane detected, and a disagreement between the two is itself a record.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 由视力正常者单独目视产出的连续性读数不成立，登记为「未经白杖复核」并不计入 count_per_km。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: A continuity reading produced by sighted observation alone does not stand; it is registered as not cane-verified and excluded from count_per_km.

readings_execution.tools_zh: 卷尺（量取设计视距）+ 手机拍照；抽检在公共空间内进行，不触碰、不移动、不清洁任何牌面。
readings_execution.tools_en: A tape for the design viewing distance and a phone camera; spot-checks take place in public space and never touch, move or clean a panel.
readings_execution.sample_reference_zh: 抽检样本量参考：每类牌面不少于 10 面或该类全数（取小者）；同一批样本在日间、夜间、雨天各复测一轮。
readings_execution.sample_reference_en: Reference sample size: at least ten panels of each type, or all of them where fewer; the same batch is re-tested once by day, once at night and once in rain.
readings_execution.validity_conditions_zh: 三轮复测须为同一批 panel_id，样本替换须登记原因；雨轮在降雨期间完成。
readings_execution.validity_conditions_en: All three rounds use the same panel_id batch, any substitution is registered with its reason, and the rain round is completed during rainfall.
readings_execution.invalidation_zh: 牌面被临时物遮挡时登记为遮挡失败而不是不可测：遮挡本身就是可读性结论的一部分。
readings_execution.invalidation_en: A panel blocked by a temporary object is registered as an obstruction failure, not as unmeasurable: the obstruction is itself part of the legibility finding.

record_field_definitions.note_zh: 全部记录采用同一组基础字段加逐项扩展字段。基础字段中 unmeasurable_reason 为必填项之一：可测点位填空字符串，不可测点位必须填写原因——分母不得删除失败样本这一既有纪律，在记录格式层面由该字段强制。
record_field_definitions.note_en: Every record uses one common base field set plus per-reading extensions. Among the base fields unmeasurable_reason is mandatory: measurable points carry an empty string, unmeasurable points must state the cause. The standing discipline that failed samples are never dropped from the denominator is enforced at record-format level by this field.
record_field_definitions.identity_rule_zh: 任何记录不得包含被观察者的姓名、面部、车牌、可识别衣着描述或可用于再识别的组合信息；断点照片须在拍摄当场确认无可识别人像，无法避让时不拍。
record_field_definitions.identity_rule_en: No record may contain a name, face, licence plate, identifying description of clothing or any combination permitting re-identification of an observed person; break photographs are confirmed free of identifiable persons at the moment of capture, and where that cannot be arranged the photograph is not taken.

accessibility_route_protocol.name_zh: 无障碍路径实测协议：屏幕阅读器与障碍点普查
accessibility_route_protocol.name_en: Accessibility route protocol: screen reader and obstacle census

screen_reader_test.scope_zh: 对象是现状遗址公园沿线可在公共空间接触到的数字路径：公开可访问的导览页面、扫码信息页、公共交通与地图应用中与本走廊相关的路径查询，以及现场二维码指向的任何公开页面。不测试任何需要账户、需要授权或属于受限系统的界面。
screen_reader_test.scope_en: The subject is the digital routes reachable from public space along the existing heritage corridor: publicly accessible guide pages, scan-to-read information pages, corridor-related route queries in public transport and map applications, and any public page a on-site QR code points to. No interface requiring an account, an authorisation or belonging to a restricted system is tested.
method_zh: 以 VoiceOver（iOS）与 TalkBack（Android）各完成一次同一任务，任务为「从当前位置到达指定节点并读出到达确认」。
全程仅使用屏幕阅读器手势，不看屏幕；每一步登记朗读内容、是否可焦点到达、是否可返回上一步。
记录三类失败：焦点陷阱（无法离开某元素）、无名控件（朗读为按钮但无名称）、状态不播报（视觉有变化而朗读无变化）。
同一任务在 AI 关闭等价路径下复做一次：若该路径只有视觉指引而无可朗读等价物，登记为等价缺口而非测试失败。
method_en: The same task is completed once with VoiceOver on iOS and once with TalkBack on Android, the task being to reach a named node from the current position and read out the arrival confirmation.
Screen-reader gestures only, with the screen unseen; each step registers what was spoken, whether focus could reach it and whether the previous step could be returned to.

Three failure classes are logged: focus traps where an element cannot be left, unnamed controls announced as a button with no name, and unannounced state where the visual changes and the speech does not.
The same task is repeated on the AI-off equivalent route: where that route offers visual guidance with no speakable equivalent, this is registered as an equivalence gap rather than a test failure.
screen_reader_test.limits_zh: 本测试只覆盖公开可访问界面，不构成对任何系统的无障碍符合性评价，也不替代 WCAG 或国家标准的正式评测。
screen_reader_test.limits_en: The test covers publicly accessible interfaces only. It is not an accessibility conformance evaluation of any system and does not substitute for formal assessment against WCAG or national standards.

obstacle_census.method_zh: 沿基线路径逐点登记物理障碍：净宽不足、纵横坡、高差、缺口、占压、井盖冲突、临时堆放、无坡化路缘。每点量测并拍照，位置以手机定位截图佐证。
obstacle_census.method_en: Physical obstacles are registered point by point along the baseline route: insufficient clear width, longitudinal and cross slope, level difference, gap, obstruction, manhole conflict, temporary storage and unramped kerb. Each point is measured and photographed, its position evidenced by a phone location screenshot.
obstacle_census.slope_caveat_zh: 坡度以手机水平仪应用读取，属未标定读数，仅用于筛出需专业复测的点位，不得与任何规范限值比较。
obstacle_census.slope_caveat_en: Slope is read from a phone level application, an uncalibrated reading used only to flag points needing professional re-measurement, never compared against a standard's limit.

minimum_interview_set.purpose_zh: 在没有任何授权主体、没有经费、没有机构背书的条件下，仍能取得一批可核对的使用者证词，用以校正六项技术读数的解释。访谈不产出指标数值，只产出证词与失败样本。
minimum_interview_set.purpose_en: To obtain a checkable body of user testimony without an authorising body, a budget or institutional backing, so that the interpretation of the six technical readings can be corrected. Interviews produce no metric value, only testimony and failure samples.

respondent_types.focus_zh: 日常路径、夜间与雨天的实际绕行、被否决过或想否决的点位
respondent_types.focus_en: Daily routes, actual detours at night and in rain, and points they have vetoed or would veto

respondent_types.focus_zh: 首层界面的实际使用、现金与人工替代的真实需求、补给时段与人行通行的冲突
respondent_types.focus_en: Actual use of the ground-floor frontage, real demand for cash and human alternatives, and conflicts between resupply windows and pedestrian movement

respondent_types.focus_zh: 停留与休息的真实位置、导视是否被使用、AI 关闭态下的做法
respondent_types.focus_en: Where they actually stop and rest, whether wayfinding is used at all, and what they do when the AI layer is off

minimum_interview_set.sample_note_zh: 以上人数为参考量而非目标量：本计划不承诺达到任一数字，实际完成量与拒访量一并登记。拒访不是损耗，是一条记录。
minimum_interview_set.sample_note_en: These counts are reference magnitudes, not targets: the plan promises none of them, and the completed count is registered alongside the refusal count. A refusal is not attrition; it is a record.
question_frame_zh: 信息获取通道：上一次在这条路上没看懂或没听清任何信息，是什么时候，当时怎么办的。
沟通方式：需要问人的时候，能问到谁；问不到时改做什么。
行动方式：这条路上有没有必须绕开的地方；绕多远。
认知与感官处理：有没有哪一段让你想尽快走完或选择不走。
语言与数字门槛：不用手机能不能完成同一件事；试过没有。
服务提供与维护：坏了的东西多久修好；你怎么知道它坏了。
question_frame_en: Information channel: the last time you could not read or hear any information on this route, when was it and what did you do.
Communication mode: when you need to ask someone, who is there to ask, and what do you do instead when nobody is.
Movement mode: is there anywhere on this route you must go around, and how far around.
Cognitive and sensory processing: is there a stretch you want to get through quickly, or choose not to walk at all.
Language and digital thresholds: can you complete the same thing without a phone, and have you tried.
Service provision and maintenance: how long until a broken thing is fixed, and how do you know it is broken.
ethics_boundary_zh: 匿名：不记录姓名、住址、单位、联系方式；记录编号与人不建立可回溯映射。
知情同意：口头说明用途、去向与可撤回性后方可开始；拒绝即结束，不追问原因。
撤回：受访者可在任何时点要求删除本次记录，删除不需理由，删除动作当场完成并当面确认。
不记录个体身份：不录音、不拍摄受访者、不记录可识别特征；证词以要点转述形式登记。
合理便利：受访者可自选沟通方式（口头、书写、指认、手语在场）；无法提供其所需便利时，本次访谈不进行。
申诉：受访者取得一张写明本次记录编号与撤回方式的纸条，纸条不含任何受访者信息。
ethics_boundary_en: Anonymity: no name, address, affiliation or contact is recorded, and no traceable mapping is created between a record number and a person.
Informed consent: purpose, destination and revocability are explained aloud before starting; a refusal ends the approach and its reason is never pursued.
Withdrawal: a respondent may require deletion of the record at any moment, needs no reason, and the deletion is performed on the spot and confirmed in their presence.
No individual identity recorded: no audio, no photograph of the respondent, no identifying characteristic; testimony is registered as a paraphrase of its substance.

Reasonable accommodation: respondents choose the communication mode, spoken, written, pointing, or with a signer present; where the accommodation they need cannot be provided, the interview does not proceed.
Appeal: each respondent receives a slip carrying the record number and the way to withdraw, and the slip carries nothing about the respondent.

roles_and_schedule.executing_role_zh: 提交者本人或其自愿邀请的志愿者。本方案没有已组建的团队、没有受雇人员、没有机构授权，此处不虚构任何角色。白杖实探项须有白杖使用者本人参与，该项在找到自愿参与者之前不执行，不以模拟替代。
roles_and_schedule.executing_role_en: The submitter in person, or volunteers they invite. This proposal has no assembled team, no employed staff and no institutional mandate, and invents no role here. The cane-probing item requires a cane user to take part; until a willing participant is found the item is not executed, and simulation never substitutes for it.
roles_and_schedule.time_frame_zh: 六项读数中四项（绕行系数、过街等待、触觉带连续性、导视可读性日间轮）可在任一自然日的日间完成，无季节与审批依赖；夜间断点须在日落后两小时内；雨天断点与导视可读性雨轮须在降雨期间或雨停 30 分钟内，因此该两项的执行时点由天气决定而不是由计划决定。
roles_and_schedule.time_frame_en: Four of the six readings, detour factor, crossing wait, tactile-band continuity and the daytime signage round, can be completed in daylight on any calendar day with no seasonal or approval dependency. Night breaks fall within two hours after sunset. Wet-weather breaks and the signage rain round must occur during rainfall or within thirty minutes of its ending, so weather rather than the plan fixes when those two happen.
roles_and_schedule.no_date_commitment_zh: 本计划不给出开始日期、不给出完成期限、不给出里程碑排期。给出排期会使一个尚无授权主体、尚无人员的计划看起来像已排定的工作，那是不实陈述。
roles_and_schedule.no_date_commitment_en: The plan states no start date, no completion deadline and no milestone schedule. Stating one would make a plan with no authorising body and no personnel look like scheduled work, which would be a false statement.

legal_prudence.name_zh: 合规审慎声明：执行前的辖区确认义务
legal_prudence.name_en: Legal prudence: the executor's duty to confirm jurisdiction before running
statement_zh: 本计划所列测量与访谈均为公共空间内的零授权活动设计：全部动作以公众身份在公共可进入空间内完成，不进入受限区域、不触碰设施、不采集个体身份信息。
但零授权是本计划的设计口径，不是对任何辖区法律状态的判断。执行者在任何辖区开展前须自行确认当地对公共空间测量、拍摄与访谈活动的法律与管理要求，其中包含铁路沿线区域的特殊管理规定；存在不确定时不执行。
本包不构成对任何辖区合规性的判断，也不代替具备资质的法务意见。本条不是免责措辞，而是执行前置条件：确认未完成即视为条件不成立，该项不得开始。
statement_en: Every measurement and interview in this plan is designed as a zero-authorisation activity in public space: all actions are performed as a member of the public in publicly enterable space, entering no restricted area, touching no equipment and collecting no individual identity data.

Zero-authorisation is this plan's design caliber, not a judgement about the legal position in any jurisdiction. Before running anything in any jurisdiction the executor must confirm for themselves what local law and administrative rules require of measurement, photography and interviewing in public space, including the special rules governing land along railways; where that is uncertain, the item is not executed.

This package makes no compliance judgement for any jurisdiction and substitutes for no qualified legal advice. This clause is not a disclaimer but a precondition of execution: until the confirmation is complete the condition does not hold and the item may not begin.
legal_prudence.execution_decision_zh: 执行决定为暂缓：方法作为方案交付物保留，执行与否及其时点由未来经授权主体在完成合规确认后决定。本文件不因此改变任何读数，六项读数仍全部为零值或 unknown。
legal_prudence.execution_decision_en: The execution decision is deferred: the method is retained as a deliverable of the proposal, while whether and when it runs is for a future authorised body to settle once its own compliance confirmation is complete. Nothing here changes any reading; all six remain zero or unknown.

data_backfill.target_files_en: First-round field values are written back into the corresponding reading entries of visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json, which is currently definitions-only-no-values, while this file registers the batch and its execution record. None of the seven inclusion metrics changes because of any reading here; the two sets of definitions share no denominator.
